finding.type: Source-contract precision correction, not a demonstrated existing runtime defect
finding.oldAmbiguity: Marking every file-associated Type/relation descriptor retained-file-schema could downgrade a descriptor already active in Page/Bookmark schema, such as a shared name or description.
finding.resolution: fileSchemaOnly = fileSchemaIDs minus activePageBookmarkSchemaIDs; uninstantiated = allDefinitionIDs minus activePageBookmarkSchemaIDs minus fileSchemaOnly. Existing active roles take precedence. File heads retain distinct retained-file-attachment-head roles.

verdict.scope: One original generic FileObject533/layout6 attachment closure per admitted head/payload, with exactly one distinct supported Page/Bookmark referring owner, exact ordinary property order, one original variant and no unconsumed census entry.
implementationConditions: Implement exact byte-oriented identity/normalization refusal, complete self+generated-block+ordinary detail census, and closed metadata/body validation described by the contract; do not replace these with constructor shape alone.
Only capturedComplete with the full admitted nonempty closure may enter the new path. The preserved recovered-v1 and empty-file paths must retain old canonical bytes and refusal behavior.
File operations must be attributed to the verified mapped referring document and ordered after owner creation and before deferred property writes; shared-owner/payload ambiguities remain refused.

Complete original file heads, trees, protobuf, FileInfo keys and variant metadata stay exact in the private archive/source catalog. Retention does not make File/media layouts editable or confer destination authority.

Keep existing prepared clients, native owner/current Writer checks, App namespace ownership, E outer-operation lifetime, C14 and current run/lease admission unchanged. The W3 whole Directory prerequisite remains explicit.
No archive budget increase; unchanged64MiB maximum includes complete retained source material.
